title: Beef Stir Fry
description: Quick and flavorful beef stir fry made with soy and a hint of vanilla.
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the wok and set aside.
Add the garlic and green onions to the wok and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the wok and stir to coat with the soy sauce mixture.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the beef is cooked to your liking.
Serve hot and garnish with vanilla, if desired.
